$comment: What leaves this machine (F-TL-07). The app's Settings > Privacy table and the website's /privacy are built from this file; keep it true to what the shipped build does. `state` says how a row's On/Off is decided: a setting's value, `on_use` (sent only when the user runs that action), `signed_in`, or an org policy field.

features.label: Account and plan
features.sends: Your email, plan checks, and this device's name and platform at sign-in

features.label: Thread titles
features.sends: The opening message of a new thread

features.label: Dictionary hints
features.sends: Your dictionary terms, with each cloud take

features.label: Dictionary sync
features.sends: Your dictionary rules (words, replacements and their options), never transcripts or audio

features.label: Enhance and Polish
features.sends: Transcript text, when you press Enhance or Polish

features.label: Create teammate with AI
features.sends: The job description you type, when you press Draft

features.label: Find work ranking
features.sends: Your search, and the names, titles and last lines of open panes, threads and teammates, redacted; never file contents

features.label: Conductor calls
features.sends: Your voice during a call, and what Conductor reads to answer you: the names, titles and status of your panes, threads and teammates, and tool results such as an agent's closing message or a review item's summary, redacted
features.destination: Vibezeo API → realtime voice provider and Anthropic (Claude API)

features.label: Usage statistics
features.sends: Feature counts and timings, from an allowlist

features.label: Crash reports
features.sends: Stack traces and the app version

features.label: Team audit log
features.sends: That Full access was used or a plugin write approved (no content)
